subject.title: [Bug] Agent context window fragmentation during concurrent subagent tool calls

question: Should concurrent subagent completions remain push-based in completion order, or should OpenClaw add an explicit ordered spawn-group/join mode for callers that need spawn-order aggregation?
rationale: Both semantics are defensible, but unconditional buffering would change latency, failure handling, and established sessions_yield behavior without evidence of identity loss.

options.title: Keep push completion order
options.body: Keep the current identity-bearing completion events and require a concrete mis-correlation reproduction before changing runtime semantics.

options.title: Add explicit ordered join
options.body: Sponsor a separate opt-in spawn-group or join contract with defined timeout, cancellation, and partial-result behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep push completion order
recommendation.body: Keep the current identity-bearing completion events and require a concrete mis-correlation reproduction before changing runtime semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history links this person most directly to sessions_yield and subagent completion orchestration semantics.
